node.statement: The live derivation uses validated nodes 1.3.2.2.3 and 1.3.2.2.4 only: node 1.3.2.2.3 gives Y^dagger dot V=(sum_i<Y_i,V_i>)*u_Q, while the registered definition column-hilbert-inner-product-displays, as recorded in node 1.3.2.2.4, gives <Y,V>_n=sum_i<Y_i,V_i>. Substitution proves Y^dagger dot V=<Y,V>_n*u_Q. The contrary rescaling assertion in node 1.3.2.2.2 is false in the provisioned context because it violates this registered definition; it is not a premise of this derivation and must have its erroneous validation revoked and then be archived by a verifier, since AF forbids a prover from unvalidating an already validated node.
